verses.1:
“Yes, in those days and at that time,
 when I restore Judah and Jerusalem from captivity, + 3:1 Or restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem
verses.2:
I will gather all the nations
 and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. + 3:2 Jehoshaphat means the LORD judges ; also in verse 12. 
 There I will enter into judgment against them
 concerning My people, My inheritance, Israel,
 whom they have scattered among the nations
 as they divided up My land.
verses.4: Now what do you have against Me, O Tyre, Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Are you rendering against Me a recompense? If you retaliate against Me, I will swiftly and speedily return your recompense upon your heads.
verses.5: For you took My silver and gold and carried off My finest treasures to your temples. + 3:5 Or palaces
verses.6: You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, + 3:6 Or to the peoples of Javan to send them far from their homeland.
verses.7: Behold, I will rouse them from the places to which you sold them; I will return your recompense upon your heads.
verses.8:
I will sell your sons and daughters into the hands of the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans — to a distant nation.”
 Indeed, the LORD has spoken.
verses.10:
Beat your plowshares into swords
 and your pruning hooks into spears.
 Let the weak say, ‘I am strong!’
verses.11:
Come quickly, all you surrounding nations,
 and gather yourselves.
 Bring down Your mighty ones,
 O LORD.
verses.12:
Let the nations be roused
 and advance to the Valley of Jehoshaphat,
 for there I will sit down
 to judge all the nations on every side.
verses.13:
Swing the sickle,
 for the harvest is ripe. + 3:13 LXX the harvest has come ; see also Mark 4:29|MRK 4:29 . 
 Come, trample the grapes,
 for the winepress is full;
 the wine vats overflow
 because their wickedness is great.
verses.14:
Multitudes, multitudes
 in the valley of decision!
 For the Day of the LORD is near
 in the valley of decision.
verses.15:
The sun and moon will grow dark,
 and the stars will no longer shine.
verses.16:
The LORD will roar from Zion
 and raise His voice from Jerusalem;
 heaven and earth will tremble.
 But the LORD will be a refuge for His people,
 a stronghold for the people of Israel.
 Blessings for God’s People
verses.17:
Then you will know that I am the LORD your God,
 who dwells in Zion, My holy mountain.
 Jerusalem will be holy,
 never again to be overrun by foreigners.
verses.18:
And in that day the mountains will drip with sweet wine,
 and the hills will flow with milk.
 All the streams of Judah will run with water,
 and a spring will flow from the house of the LORD
 to water the Valley of Acacias. + 3:18 Or Valley of Shittim
verses.19:
Egypt will become desolate,
 and Edom a desert wasteland,
 because of the violence done to the people of Judah,
 in whose land they shed innocent blood.
verses.20:
But Judah will be inhabited forever,
 and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
verses.21:
For I will avenge their blood,
 which I have not yet avenged. + 3:21 Or For I will pardon their bloodguilt, which I have not yet pardoned. ”
 For the LORD dwells in Zion.
